<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex400122026-09-1602-45-29" status="unreviewed"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4264">gnyags</rs> na re chod ma gsal ba dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sgo nas yul dang rnaM yid la
            long spyod pa yin pa na kun gzhi' dang nyan yid la chod pa gsal ba dang mtshungs par lta
               <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="29a7"/> bab pas nyes spyod kyi mtshan nyid 'dzin pa ma yod zhes zer de la yang
            gnas byas pa'i sgo nas nyid spyod 'dzin pa ni migs pas laso pa drug ka yin te | gnas
            byas pa'i sgo nas nyes spyod 'dzin pa zhes pa yod pa'o ||</seg></TEI>
